scope: m=14 reduced mixed-boundary evolution on a prescribed finite background interval from sufficiently small common-zero-collar H14 x H13 data; strong time-jet continuity and data dependence
checks: angular projection is never commuted through variable coefficients
radial time-energy corrections remove weak spatial-form derivative without assuming H2 first
finite stencil converts time derivatives to spatial differential polynomials with correct total orders
known protected precontact field controls cutoff seed terms
spatial Gagliardo-Nirenberg product estimate is linear in high norms
pointwise normal-recovery cost is retained and absorbed by spatial interpolation plus low energy
whole-interval exponential envelope controls finite recent-iterate stencil
energy difference convergence is factorial or weighted contraction
one-order-lower Lipschitz and top comparison incur only the displayed extra derivative
compactly supported smoothing rates yield Bona-Smith strong top continuity
excluded_claims: general arbitrary nonzero-corner finite-Sobolev restart theorem
physical constraint propagation or gauge completion
Big Bang, novelty, global stability, publication readiness
qualification: This is an analytic review record, not a machine proof of the PDE theorem; source edits invalidate the exact-source acceptance.
